question: Which destinations are recommended for autumn travel?
answer:
* Munich, Germany
* Cappadocia, Turkey
* Scottish Highlands, UK
* New England, USA
* Kyoto, Japan
contexts:
| Swiss Alps    | Switzerland | Green meadows, hiking trails and scenic train rides.                 |
| Iceland       | Iceland     | Midnight sun, waterfalls and the Golden Circle at their best.        |

## n AUTUMN (September - November)

Golden foliage, harvest festivals and pleasant temperatures create a photographer's dream.

| Destination        | Country   | Why Visit                                                         |
|--------------------|-----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Kyoto              | Japan     | Fiery red and orange maple leaves (koyo) around historic temples. |
| New England        | USA       | Legendary fall foliage across Vermont, New Hampshire and Maine.   |
| Munich             | Germany   | Oktoberfest celebrations and crisp Bavarian autumn air.           |
| Cappadocia         | Turkey    | Balloon rides over surreal valleys in clear, cool skies.          |
| Scottish Highlands | UK        | Golden glens, misty lochs and dramatic autumn light.              |

| Cappadocia         | Turkey    | Balloon rides over surreal valleys in clear, cool skies.          |
| Scottish Highlands | UK        | Golden glens, misty lochs and dramatic autumn light.              |

## dn WINTER (December - February)

Snowy landscapes, festive lights and warm tropical escapes offer something for every traveler.

| Destination   | Country     | Why Visit                                                     |
|---------------|-------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
| Lapland       | Finland     | Northern Lights, husky sledding and authentic Santa villages. |
| Zermatt       | Switzerland | Premier skiing beneath the iconic Matterhorn.                 |
| Maldives      | Maldives    | Warm tropical escape with clear seas and overwater villas.    |
| Vienna        | Austria     | Magical Christmas markets and grand imperial architecture.    |
| Banff         | Canada      | Frozen lakes, snowy peaks and cozy mountain resorts.          |

Tip: Seasons are reversed in the Southern Hemisphere - plan destinations like Patagonia, New Zealand and Australia accordingly.

## Top Tourist Places by Season

## n SPRING (March - May)

Mild weather, blooming flowers and fewer crowds make spring ideal for gardens, festivals and countryside travel.

| Destination     | Country     | Why Visit                                                                         |
|-----------------|-------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Kyoto           | Japan       | Cherry blossom (sakura) season transforms temples and rivers into pink canopies.  |
| Amsterdam       | Netherlands | Keukenhof tulip gardens burst into color; canal cruises in gentle weather.        |
| Paris           | France      | Blooming gardens, café terraces and comfortable sightseeing before summer crowds. |
| Washington D.C. | USA         | National Cherry Blossom Festival around the Tidal Basin.                          |
| Provence        | France      | Rolling green hills and early wildflowers across the countryside.                 |
